verify_client.description: Functions to validate client identity fields and check required documents.

verify_name.description: Validate that the client's name is present and follows expected rules (letters, spaces, hyphens, minimum length).

name.description: Full name of the client to validate.

reason.description: If invalid, a short human-readable reason.

verify_email.description: Validate that the client's email address is syntactically correct and optionally check deliverability (MX lookup when supported).

check_mx.description: Optional flag to attempt MX/deliverability checks if the environment allows.

mx_checked.description: True when MX/deliverability check was attempted.

deliverable.description: True if deliverability check succeeded or indicates deliverable (when checked).

check_documents.description: Check a client's documents against an expected checklist and report completion status for each required item.

client_id.description: Identifier for the client whose documents will be checked.

required_documents.description: List of required document identifiers/names to verify presence/completion for. If omitted, a default checklist will be used.

all_completed.description: True when every required document is present and marked completed.

description: Agent that validates client name and email, and checks whether required client documents are present and completed.
name: client-analysis-agent

skills.name: Client Data Validation
skills.description: Validates client name and email according to configurable rules.

skills.name: Document Completion Check
skills.description: Checks required documents for presence and completion state.

skills.name: Error Handling
skills.description: Reports and logs validation or checking errors with helpful diagnostics.
